functional_semantics.triton: Grouped 1-D cross-correlation, no bias, zero padding by masking, out_L = (L + 2p - kL)//s + 1 (impl_triton.py 42-43, 59-73, 150).
functional_semantics.cutile: Same semantics: flattened (ic_local, kl) reduction, zero padding by clamp+mask, out_L identical (impl_cutile.py 53-54, 71-99, 160).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise F.conv1d(input, weight, bias=None, stride, padding, groups) (impl_torch.py 7-14); output (batch, out_channels, out_L) in the input dtype on both sides.

stages.triton: torch.empty output (153) then one implicit-GEMM kernel launch over (ceil(batch*out_L/rows), ceil(Cout_g/cols), groups) (impl_triton.py 180-204).
stages.cutile: torch.empty output (163-164), flat views (166-168), one implicit-GEMM kernel launch with the same 3-axis grid (impl_cutile.py 209-218).
stages.note: Identical single-kernel structure; no im2col, no padded copy, no second pass.

dependencies.triton: Output tiles are independent; the only dependency is the sequential reduction loop inside a program (impl_triton.py 55-96).
dependencies.cutile: Same: independent output tiles, sequential in-program reduction loop (impl_cutile.py 67-118).
dependencies.note: No inter-program dependency on either side.

reduction_scan_sort.triton: Sequential loop over the flattened Cin_g*kL axis, channel-major/tap-minor, each chunk folded by tl.dot into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K, no atomics (impl_triton.py 54-60, 96).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: Same flattening (ic_local = f // kL, kl = f % kL), sequential chunks folded by ct.mma into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K, no atomics (impl_cutile.py 67-72, 117-118).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Same reduction structure and enumeration order; intra-chunk order is the MMA hardware's on both sides.

precision.triton: fp32 accumulator (51); tl.dot(..., input_precision="tf32") so fp32 operands are TF32-rounded, fp16 native (96); cast to output dtype at store (106).
precision.cutile: fp32 accumulator (62); operands cast to ct.tfloat32 when input is fp32, else native (65, 117-118); cast to output dtype before scatter (137).
precision.note: Same precision class: TF32 operands for fp32 inputs, fp32 accumulation, output in the input dtype. config.yaml verify atol 1e-1 / rtol 1e-2 is sized for this.

preprocessing.triton: Contiguity asserts and scalar metadata only (145-151); no cast/transpose/pack; nothing cached (impl_triton.py 145-178).
preprocessing.cutile: Contiguity asserts, scalar metadata, zero-copy .view(-1) of input/weight/output (155-168); nothing cached (impl_cutile.py 155-183).
preprocessing.note: Neither side performs device-side preprocessing; everything inside run() is timed and matches the metric formulas.

intermediate_storage.triton: None; accumulator in registers, output written once (impl_triton.py 51, 106).
intermediate_storage.cutile: None; accumulator in tile space, output written once via scatter (impl_cutile.py 62, 138).
intermediate_storage.note: No global scratch on either side.

mutation.triton: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_triton.py 153).
mutation.cutile: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_cutile.py 163-164).
mutation.note: Idempotent on both sides; contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Neither side dispatches on hardware; the contract pins nothing.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: batch * in_channels * L * dtype_size + out_channels * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size * dtype_size + batch * out_channels * ((L + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) * dtype_size
fq_boundary.flops_expr: 2 * batch * out_channels * ((L + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size
fq_boundary.note: config.yaml 27-35. Counts one read of input and weight, one write of output and 2 flops per MAC; both run() bodies contain only metadata, an uninitialised output allocation and one kernel, with no prepacked operand or scratch. The kernel_size-fold cache re-reads of overlapping windows are not counted (compulsory-traffic convention) on both sides equally.
